notes: This leaf, numbered 54 at the head, continues the functorial description of the relative group E_X/Y^T and defines it by a kernel in formula (11). It lists geometric-point and affine versions, adds a note about nonunique isomorphism, then begins a case involving a universal homotopy exact sequence in dimension 1. The final sentence continues off this leaf and is not completed.

The complete original page and both native-resolution halves were inspected once. Twenty-two saved contextual or focused crops were inspected visually. No OCR, other page witnesses, PDF text layer, external research, or TeX compilation was used. Only the supplied current notation table informed the unresolved geometric-point letter ordering.

Eight visible Z-to-T overwrites are preserved: two on main line 4, three superscripts in (11), one initial variable of the parenthesized triple, and two superscripts in the lower Car note. The ordinary T letters in the later main paragraph and the NB note were not converted into overwrites without visible diagonal Z strokes.

The left E-shaped symbol of (11) is heavily blackened. It remains doubtful. A second separate E, as printed by H, is not securely visible; no readable or illegible deleted letter is invented solely from the darkening.

Focused margin crops p19 and p20 followed the whole-margin crop only because the punctuation extent was still unsettled. They establish the exclamation and a closing parenthesis; no opening parenthesis was established. The candidate therefore preserves non unique !) with an unmatched closing parenthesis.

The short ink group after Car is not a speck: it has a point-like initial body, a low returning stroke and detached oblique mark. It is transcribed explicitly and uncertainly as où|à. The grammatical difficulty of either reading is retained for adjudication, not repaired by deleting the ink.

The lower broad curve in the Car crop is the neighbouring main-text opening parenthesis before avec, not a closing parenthesis or punctuation belonging to the margin. A terminal stop after épi is not securely isolated.
The literal equality X=Y in the later parenthesis is preserved. It may be an authorial slip for X/Y, but the two equality strokes are visible and no correction is made in the text.

The opening parenthesis at the beginning of the leaf and the continued last sentence are not balanced or completed. The quotation uses paired upright ticks rather than guillemets. Abbreviations p.r., généralt, p^t, dim, isom, and the uncertain simplem^t are not expanded in the transcription.

Margin crops are rotated -45 degrees for viewing. Their boxes retain original image coordinates. Tight rectangular crops of the oblique notes necessarily intersect isolated fragments of horizontal body writing; those fragments are identified as neighbouring context and the complete body passages remain in the candidate and other audit boxes.

All-ink baseline count: 17 main + 6 NB-margin + 3 Car-margin + 1 supralinear insertion + 2 standalone numbers = 29. The formula label (11), degree numerals and superscript corrections share their formula/text baselines.
No independent proof of the kernel/functoriality claims or homotopy statement was attempted. This report records the manuscript reading and page-local notation checks only.

Independent audit: a dark small loop in subscript position on X in the parenthesized triple was absent from both drafts and the first reading. It is now transcribed as an uncertain 0/point. No indexed X is defined here; the surrounding unindexed triples do not justify erasing the visible mark or declaring a mathematical correction. The 0-connexes/connexe ending remains explicitly open. The formula (11) blackening does not establish two separate alphabetic layers.
